text:
Market today: Yields are the main driver, pushing higher on strong economic data. This is bad news for growth names, especially leveraged ones like yours.

Your holdings: SOXL (-35.37%) and SPAL (-30.28%) are the clear SELL signals. They are leveraged tech ETFs and are getting hammered by rising rates and decay. METU (+55.57%) and MUU (+1.18%) are also leveraged and need watching, though they are currently profitable.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. It's at a 19-year high and is the primary headwind for your concentrated tech book.

Bottom line: Rising yields are the enemy right now. Focus on managing your risk in the leveraged names.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this position given the SELL status and significant loss. The leveraged nature amplifies downside in this environment.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is a SELL. Evaluate cutting losses to preserve capital, especially on margin.
ARM: Watch the entry zone of 327.87-327.54. If price pulls back into this area, it could be a potential new buy if conviction builds.
